project_overview: This project appears to be a front-end application likely built with Vue.js, utilizing a component-based architecture. The dependency graph reveals a significant reliance on direct imports from lower-level components (e.g., DataTable, ImageGallery) into higher-level components (e.g., AdminSettings, UserDashboard). This suggests a potential layering issue and risks associated with tightly coupled components. The reliance on router navigation for several components also warrants further investigation for potential performance bottlenecks and complexity.

macro_trends.title: High Dependency Coupling
macro_trends.description: Numerous direct imports from lower-level components (DataTable, ImageGallery, SearchBar) into higher-level components (AdminSettings, UserDashboard) indicate a high degree of coupling. This creates a significant risk of cascading changes and potential performance issues.  A code review focusing on refactoring to reduce direct imports is highly recommended.

key_workflows.name: Admin Settings Navigation
key_workflows.description: The 'Router push to AdminSettings' connections show that the AdminSettings component is frequently navigated to via the application router. This suggests AdminSettings might be a central component, but the heavy reliance on direct imports into it could create points of failure. Performance considerations regarding this navigation should be prioritized.
